test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Pointing to a man, Rahul said, "He is the son of my father's only son."

How is the man related to Rahul?
solution:
Given: "He is the son of my father's only son."

"My father's only son" refers to Rahul himself

"Son of [Rahul]" refers to the man in question.

Consolidated Family Structure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b9bc21c44da2d4a106fd9843d1aab3584f14d9ae1a15601562625e28c1f4068.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b0545e60db8af984395201026e82066fbe94e175b0854bd3b6183b3d647a347.png] 

 

Thus, the man is the Son of Rahul.

 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
